Chapter 7: Mastering the Art of Earning More
Now that you’ve built a solid foundation and a supportive network, let’s dive into the real nuts and bolts—how you can actually start earning more. You know, earning more isn’t just about working longer hours. It’s really about working smarter, making the most of your strengths, and spotting opportunities that truly match your goals and values.
To begin, take a good look at where your money’s coming from right now. Are there places where you could grow? Maybe it’s time to ask for that raise, go after a promotion, or try out a side hustle you’ve been considering. If you’re running your own business, think about expanding your product line, raising your prices, or even exploring new markets.
Here’s a way to picture it—imagine your income as a river fed by several small streams. If you only depend on one, a dry spell can hit hard. But if you have lots of streams flowing in, you’ll be much more resilient and might even see abundance where you didn’t expect it.
So, how do you build those income streams? Let’s talk practical strategies:
First, make it a habit to review and update your skills. The more current and competitive you are, the more valuable you become.
Next, don’t be shy about asking for what you’re worth. That could mean negotiating your salary, setting fair prices for your services, or making sure your business deals reflect your value.
Think about diversifying your income, too. Maybe that’s a side project, some smart investments, or looking into passive income ideas.
And of course, let technology and automation do some heavy lifting for you. The right tools can save you time and help you reach more people.
Now, let’s be real—sometimes it’s not just about knowing what to do, but getting past what holds you back. Maybe you worry about being rejected, or self-promotion feels awkward, or you hesitate to charge more. These are common roadblocks, especially for women. The good news? You can work through them—by practicing negotiation conversations, asking for feedback, and making a point to celebrate even the small wins.
Remember, earning more isn’t only about the dollar signs. It’s about opening up new choices, and creating a life that feels true to your deepest values. Every step you take to boost your income is really a step toward more freedom, and more opportunity to make a real impact—not just for yourself, but for those around you.
